params.name: ply
params.comment: sheet thickness; every opening is through it

params.name: finger
params.comment: the shortest cell along an edge

params.name: temp_c
params.comment: the air's temperature, warm from the breath, degrees C

params.name: c_mm_s
params.comment: speed of sound, mm/s

params.name: a4
params.comment: concert pitch, Hz

params.name: window_w
params.comment: the window across, the duct's width

params.name: window_l
params.comment: the window along the jet

params.name: mouth
params.comment: scales the window's end correction (the generator's --mouth)

params.name: rayleigh
params.comment: end correction per radius, a flanged end

params.name: kw
params.comment: the window's conductance

params.name: ratio_R2
params.comment: hole R2's conductance over the window's: the fingering search's result

params.name: ratio_R1
params.comment: hole R1's conductance over the window's: the fingering search's result

params.name: ratio_L1
params.comment: hole L1's conductance over the window's: the fingering search's result

params.name: ratio_L2
params.comment: hole L2's conductance over the window's: the fingering search's result

params.name: d_R2
params.comment: finger hole R2: pi d^2/4 = k (ply + rayleigh d)

params.name: d_R1
params.comment: finger hole R1: pi d^2/4 = k (ply + rayleigh d)

params.name: d_L1
params.comment: finger hole L1: pi d^2/4 = k (ply + rayleigh d)

params.name: d_L2
params.comment: finger hole L2: pi d^2/4 = k (ply + rayleigh d)

params.name: key_hz
params.comment: the closed note; by default what the generator's build sounds. Type a frequency to resize

params.name: cavity_mm3
params.comment: the cavity key_hz needs, mm3

params.name: s0
params.comment: Newton's start

params.name: s1
params.comment: Newton step

params.name: s2
params.comment: Newton step

params.name: s3
params.comment: Newton step

params.name: s4
params.comment: Newton step

params.name: edge
params.comment: the build's edge: the size that holds cavity_mm3; type a length to set it outright

params.name: s
params.comment: the scale, against the generator's build (the generator's --scale)

params.name: pitch_hz
params.comment: read only: what this build sounds closed

params.name: semitones_a4
params.comment: read only: pitch_hz in semitones from A4

params.name: beak
params.comment: the beak, out from the mouth face

params.name: beak_w
params.comment: the beak across

params.name: tip
params.comment: the beak tip's rounding, along the beak

params.name: duct_depth
params.comment: each half of the duct, engraved in the top and in the bird

params.name: bevel
params.comment: the window's far edge, filed on the outside face

params.name: row_1
params.comment: the near holes, in from the mouth wall

params.name: row_2
params.comment: the far holes, in from the mouth wall

params.name: columns
params.comment: between the two columns of holes

params.name: nip
params.comment: each corner cut back this far, square to its bisector, where more than three plates meet

params.name: room
params.comment: read only: the least web from a hole to a wall's inside face, or half the web between two; below 0 the build is too small for the hand
